name: Harlow Street refit - Whitfield Renovations
description: A 41-door kitchen and bath refit for a repeat trade client, delivered June 2025 and checked at 18 months.
audience_context: Trade contractors judged on first-year call-backs.
key_benefits: No call-back week on the contractor's calendar
The homeowner stopped asking about the finish
A standing order for the next three kitchens
measurable_results: 41 doors finished with the 320 scuff pass between every coat
Zero call-backs at the 18-month check (December 2026 site visit)
Install landed on the booked date, 2025-06-12
transformation_story: Whitfield Renovations came to Brightside after a lacquer failure on another shop's doors cost them a repeat client. Harlow Street was the trial job: 41 doors, a vanity boxed around a heating pipe the drawing never showed, and a finish schedule with a scuff pass between every coat. Eighteen months on, every door closes and none has lifted.

before.title: Before
before.description: A repeat client lost over a lifted lacquer finish on another shop's doors; the contractor ate the invoice.

after.title: After
after.description: 41 doors, scuff-sanded between every coat, 18 months in with zero call-backs and a standing order.

grid_items.transformation_details: The difference was the finish schedule: a 320-grit scuff pass between coats gives the next coat a mechanical key. The doors were checked on site at 18 months.
